The Atheist Bible

A Secular Humanist view on life, the Universe, and everything

Fabian M. Suchanek

Copyright © 2026 Fabian M. Suchanek. All rights reserved.
Published by Fabian M. Suchanek
Edited by D. Olson Pook and Jessica Kaplan
ISBN 9798184552996

This book is freely available online as a PDF, e-book, audio-book, and Web site, as well as in several print editions, at
https://suchanek.name/texts/atheism

This is the hardcover edition. The softcover edition is available with ISBN 9798184552996.

The present version of this book is v2026-10-15-NI-SC.

See the legal conditions at the end of this book or online.

The Atheist Bible

A Secular Humanist view on life, the Universe, and everything

CC-BY 2006-2026 Fabian M. Suchanek

The Atheist Bible

A Secular Humanist view on life, the Universe, and everything

CC-BY 2006-2026 Fabian M. Suchanek

This book describes a worldview without gods and the supernatural. Unlike a number of other books, it does not merely argue that God does not exist or that religion is harmful. Rather, it offers an atheist perspective on life, the Universe, morality, truth, and the meaning of life. To this end, it draws inspiration from Secular Humanism, a philosophy in the Enlightenment tradition that values every human being equally and emphasizes ethical behavior, science, democracy, human rights, and freedom of religion. The book also explores the history, functioning, tenets, diversity, benefits, and liabilities of the major world religions. Thus, it aims to be a comprehensive handbook that atheists can use to support, enrich, and scrutinize their perspective.

With more than 700 pages, 300 illustrations, 500 inspirational quotes, 1700 references, and 1500 cross-references, the Atheist Bible is likely the largest monograph on the topic. The book is licensed by the author, Fabian M. Suchanek, under a Creative Commons Attribution license. See the legal conditions at the end of the book.

Book formats

Digital formats
  • The Atheist Bible full and free online in HTML
  • The Atheist Bible as an EPUB e-book
  • The Atheist Bible as PDF
Audio formats
The Atheist Bible is available as an audio-book, narrated by an AI (ideal for commuting):
  • as an AI-generated podcast for some chapters
  • as a playlist on Youtube
  • as individual downloadable mp3 files
Social media formats
The Atheist Bible is on BlueSky, Mastodon, and Reddit, and available as RSS.

T-Shirts, hoodies, and mugs with atheist and Humanist designs can be found on Redbubble.com.

Print formats
The Atheist Bible is available in several print editions:
  • Hardcover: The standard version of the book, in A4 format, 754 pages, with graphics in decent quality. Available worldwide on Lulu.com for €67 (€48 printing, €2 Lulu.com fee, €4 taxes, €5 author, €8 shipping).
  • Softcover (ISBN 979-8184552996): Premium color version of the book, with high-quality photo reproduction and denser text layout, 827 pages, in Government Letter format. Available on Amazon.fr, Amazon.de, and other European Amazon sites for €115 (€60 printing, €7 taxes, €5 author, €43 Amazon). Available at Amazon.co.uk and certain other retailers for £139 (£50 printing, minimum £5 author, remainder split between retailer and author, depending on the retailer). Available at Amazon.com and certain other retailers for $185 ($73 printing, minimum $5 author, remainder split between retailer and author, depending on the retailer).
Prices are approximate and may vary by location, change over time, and be subject to additional taxes and fees.

Get the hardcover

Contents

Preface
The preface introduces the book from the author’s point of view.77
Atheism and Atheists
Chapter 1:Atheism1315
Defines atheism, responds to common criticisms leveled against atheism, and introduces Secular Humanism as an alternative to religion.
Chapter 2:Atheists5561
Explains what it means to be an atheist and addresses common stereotypes about atheists.
The World
Chapter 3:Truth8393
Discusses the concept of truth.
Chapter 4:The Universe129143
Gives an overview of what science knows about the Universe.
Chapter 5:Morality181203
Discusses morality and ethics from a Secular Humanist point of view.
Chapter 6:The Meaning of Life233261
Treats the principal questions of humanity: What is the meaning of life? And what happens when we die?
Gods
Chapter 7:Gods251281
Introduces an atheist view on gods.
Chapter 8:Proofs265297
Discusses proofs for the existence of gods.
Chapter 9:God of the Gaps311347
Discusses the idea (often brought forward by believers) that God is the explanation for the unexplained.
Religion
Chapter 10:Religion337377
Formally defines religions and gods and shows the diversity of today’s religions.
Chapter 11:The World Religions361403
Traces the history of religion from ancient rites to today’s world religions.
Chapter 12:Founding of Religions423469
Discusses factors that may lead to the creation of a religion.
Chapter 13:Following Religions459505
Discusses factors that may make people believe in religious statements.
Chapter 14:Memes489537
Analyses strategies that religions have developed to survive across generations.

(continued on next page)
The Abrahamic Religions
Chapter 15:The Abrahamic God539587
Discusses the god of Judaism, Christianity, Islam, Spiritualism, and the Bahai Faith.
Chapter 16:Christianity575625
Discusses the Christian worldview.
Chapter 17:Islam651713
Discusses the Muslim worldview. (For security reasons, this chapter is not available here.)
The Effects of Religion
Chapter 18:Criticism of Religion653715
Criticizes the effects of religion on people and society.
Chapter 19:Benefits of Religion709777
Discusses the positive effects of religion on people and society.
Chapter 20:Conclusion741813
Summarizes the book and provides an outlook on the future of religion, Secular Humanism, and atheism.

 

Each chapter consists of several sections, and each section of several articles. The articles are numbered as Chapter.Section.Article, and these numbers appear in cross-references as well as at the bottom of each page. Page numbers are included to meet book retail requirements.

The Atheist Bible

A Secular Humanist view on life, the Universe, and everything

Fabian M. Suchanek

Copyright © 2026 Fabian M. Suchanek. 版权所有。 Published by Fabian M. Suchanek Edited by D. Olson Pook and Jessica Kaplan ISBN 9798184552996

This book is freely available online as a PDF, e-book, audio-book, and Web site, as well as in several print editions, at https://suchanek.name/texts/atheism

This is the hardcover edition. The softcover edition is available with ISBN 9798184552996.

The present version of this book is v2026-10-15-NI-SC.

The Atheist Bible

A Secular Humanist view on life, the Universe, and everything

CC-BY 2006-2026 Fabian M. Suchanek

The Atheist Bible

A Secular Humanist view on life, the Universe, and everything

CC-BY 2006-2026 Fabian M. Suchanek

This book describes a worldview without gods and the supernatural. Unlike a number of other books, it does not merely argue that God does not exist or that religion is harmful. Rather, it offers an atheist perspective on life, the Universe, morality, truth, and the meaning of life. To this end, it draws inspiration from Secular Humanism, a philosophy in the Enlightenment tradition that values every human being equally and emphasizes ethical behavior, science, democracy, human rights, and freedom of religion. The book also explores the history, functioning, tenets, diversity, benefits, and liabilities of the major world religions. Thus, it aims to be a comprehensive handbook that atheists can use to support, enrich, and scrutinize their perspective.

With more than 700 pages, 300 illustrations, 500 inspirational quotes, 1700 references, and 1500 cross-references, the Atheist Bible is likely the largest monograph on the topic. The book is licensed by the author, Fabian M. Suchanek, under a Creative Commons Attribution license. See the legal conditions at the end of the book.

Book formats

Digital formats
The Atheist Bible full and free online in HTML The Atheist Bible as an EPUB e-book The Atheist Bible as PDF
Audio formats
The Atheist Bible is available as an audio-book, narrated by an AI (ideal for commuting): as an AI-generated podcast for some chapters as a playlist on Youtube as individual downloadable mp3 files
Social media formats
The Atheist Bible is on BlueSky, Mastodon, and Reddit, and available as RSS. T-Shirts, hoodies, and mugs with atheist and Humanist designs can be found on Redbubble.com. Print formats In printed form, the Atheist Bible will likely dwarf any other book you have. At 2 kilograms and in A4 format, it is about as heavy and large as your laptop. The Atheist Bible is available in several print editions: Hardcover: The standard version of the book, in A4 format, 754 pages, with graphics in decent quality. Available worldwide on Lulu.com for €67 (€48 printing, €2 Lulu.com fee, €4 taxes, €5 author, €8 shipping). Softcover (ISBN 979-8184552996): Premium color version of the book, with high-quality photo reproduction and denser text layout, 827 pages, in Government Letter format. Available on Amazon.fr, Amazon.de, and other European Amazon sites for €115 (€60 printing, €7 taxes, €5 author, €43 Amazon).
